correctness.rationale: Averaging over S_a×S_b is valid for the operator-norm objective over the full unrestricted convex feasible set. Internal block-zero-sum eigenvalues can be eliminated by choosing y,z as prescribed. The 3×3 normalized quotient has nontrivial Laplacian trace (a+1)x+(a+b)w and product Na xw. The universal e_v bound proves phase I; fixed-w 2×2 trace balancing and boundary feasibility give phase II; concavity of its lowest Laplacian eigenvalue plus the universal Rayleigh witness proves phase III. Independent exact-rational feasibility and quotient-trace/product checks on 1190 (a,b) pairs corroborate, but do not replace, the full symbolic three-regime proof.
